topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Why must this be? That same face, same voice, guiding my child now? I see the smile, the calculated kindness, but the weight of past memories drags at me. My steps grow heavy, each one a battle against the urge to turn back. How can I let this happen, stand by as history loops, a loop I once thought broken? The school gate is a threshold, a line drawn in the dust. I step over, my resolve a shield. Words in my throat, unspoken, a storm waiting to break. This is not about them, the innocent in the middle, but the ghosts I thought long laid to rest.
